data.narrative:
StoreDot is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised $206.5M to date. The valuation universe for Climate & Energy comprises 1 public comparable (ticker LNZA) and 8 private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, insufficient same-stage or valuation-tier overlap limited peer median applicability; only 2 adjacent-stage comparables were identified within the sector.

The stage-progression method was applied, using the $206.5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical for Series E progression to the next stage. This yielded an implied valuation of $289M. The peer-median approach was not executable due to insufficient narrow peer overlap—9 same-sector firms exist, but none satisfied the threshold of ≥3 datapoints when filtered for stage, valuation tier, or business model similarity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $246M (low) to $332M (high), centered on a median of $289M. This range reflects ±15% variance applied to the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of robust private peer comparables at identical stage and the reliance on a single triangulation method. A more precise range would require additional comparable data from same-stage Climate & Energy financings or public market repricing of LNZA and peer holdings.
